themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Articles discussing AI agents that can autonomously conduct research tasks, interact with systems, and generate insights.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Focuses on AI tools that assist developers with writing, reviewing, debugging, and managing code.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Content about AI capabilities for condensing large amounts of text, such as transcripts, reports, and articles, into concise summaries.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Articles detailing various AI platforms and software designed to aid researchers in data analysis, literature review, and discovery.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Studies and discussions on the use, impact, and user experiences with AI chatbots, particularly in areas like information seeking and health.

themes.name: AI sentiment feedback
themes.description: Covers AI applications for analyzing customer feedback, reviews, and social media to gauge sentiment and identify key themes.

themes.name: AI design research
themes.description: Explores how AI is integrated into the design process, including UI prototyping, generating design concepts, and analyzing design effectiveness.

themes.name: AI product research
themes.description: Articles focusing on AI's role in product development, testing, automation, and market analysis.

themes.name: AI research tools comparison
themes.description: Content that directly compares different AI research tools, models, or platforms based on features, accuracy, or performance.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Discusses the creation and use of AI-generated synthetic data or simulated users for research and testing purposes.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
